description: Before you pay, trade with or accept funds from an address: sanctions, hacks, phishing, mixers and scam links, with a clear verdict. Screens a wallet or contract address before you pay, trade with or accept funds from it: sanctions (OFAC), theft/hacks, phishing, money laundering, mixers, scams, fake tokens and malicious contracts, with a verdict (high-risk, suspicious, clean). Base, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche. Use before sending funds to, or accepting funds from, an address. Answers may be cached for up to 10 minutes. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.
